_implementation_notes: VIRIDIAN CITY EXTRA MAPS — Gym, Academy, Trainer House, River, interiors.
Covers: Map 85 (Viridian City Gym), Map 371 (Pokemon Center alt),
Map 38 (Trainer House lobby), Map 375 (Trainer House battle floor),
Phase 1 innocence for early-game maps. Gym is late-game content.
Giovanni is complex — not cartoonish evil. Gym trainers are loyal,
Ground-type specialists who don't know their Leader's dark side.
Trainer House prize shop (Event 10, Map 38) left as-is — purely mechanical.
Trainer House battle floor (Map 375) left as-is — purely mechanical.
Viridian River starter/Mew events (Map 40) left as-is — variable-driven cries.
Academy fusion tutorial (Event 15, Map 458) left as-is — mechanical info delivery.
Nurse heal sequence (Event 10, Map 371) left as-is — mechanical.
Maps 710/711 share many identical events — both rewritten consistently.
Event 25 on Maps 710/711 (Cinnabar Scientist) left as-is — late-game trigger.
